review_candidates.title: Brand Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description Madar Group, a member of Madar Holding International, specializes in the manufacture and distribution of diapers, detergents, liquid soaps, and shampoos. The company operates across the full consumer products value chain, from production to market delivery. Madar Group focuses on quality, affordability, and strong brand presence in household and personal care categories. Team members join a growing organization that values operational excellence and brand innovation. The company offers opportunities to contribute to impactful brands that serve a broad customer base. Role Description The Brand Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in Damascus. The Brand Manager will oversee the development and execution of brand strategies for Madar Group’s product portfolio, ensuring strong market positioning and consistent brand identity. Day-to-day tasks include analyzing market trends and consumer insights, managing brand performance metrics, and coordinating marketing campaigns across channels. The role also involves collaborating with product development, sales, and distribution teams to align branding with business objectives, preparing reports and presentations, and monitoring competitor activity. The Brand Manager will support long-term brand planning, budget management, and the implementation of promotional initiatives to drive growth and strengthen brand equity. Qualifications Strong skills in brand management, marketing planning, and campaign execution, with the ability to translate market insights into effective brand strategies. Experience in consumer goods or FMCG sectors, ideally in household or personal care products, including familiarity with manufacturing and distribution environments. Proficiency in market research, data analysis, and performance tracking using relevant tools to inform decision-making and optimize brand activities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear brand messages and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Solid project management and organizational skills, including time management, prioritization, and attention to detail under tight deadlines. Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field; advanced qualifications or certifications in brand management are an advantage. Comfort with using office productivity and marketing tools (e.g., spreadsheets, presentation software, CRM or marketing platforms); digital marketing experience is a plus. Demonstrated ability to work on-site in a fast-paced environment, show initiative, and adapt to changing market and business needs.

review_candidates.description: Our Company NEP is Australia’s leading provider of outsourced television production services. As part of this increased customer-focused vision, NEP Australia is currently seeking the services of a full-time Audio and Communications Engineer , HUB with exceptional drive and work ethics, and a brilliant technical mind. The Position You will be working in NEP’s IP-enabled Andrews Hub in Melbourne, in collaboration with engineers in Andrews Hub Sydney. These are the world’s largest networked centralised remote production centres. Connecting venues via a high bandwidth network, the Hubs enable multiple concurrent outside broadcasts. NEP’s Andrews Hubs are the most technically advanced facilities of their kind on this scale and an example of NEP’s investment in technology to meet broadcasters’ needs and create the best value production solutions for them. What You Will Do Daily you will be working with a small team of engineers, with the resources of a large international broadcast company. You will be responsible for maintaining the Audio and Communications systems, ensuring 100% up time for all events and projects. Your role will include planning, setup, and testing of systems for events and projects, along with day-to-day connectivity and quality assurance of audio and communications for Outside Broadcast and Studio productions. Applicants must have a positive attitude, be able to work to explicit deadlines, can pick up new concepts in a rapid manner and work closely with colleagues for long periods of time. Key Responsibilities But Not Limited To We do a lot of sport, so weekend and evening work are a predominant part of the role. As a key member of the team, you will be responsible for the technical quality control and management of communications system on Hub productions, including the efficient setup, operational condition, calibration, and signal standards of an Outside Broadcast or Studio production and other associated equipment assigned to projects. You will ensure the communication and audio systems are acceptably stable and responsive to HUB and field systems. Ability to establish priorities, work independently and proceed with objective without supervision. Strong knowledge of remote signal paths and feed allocation and management. Day to day upkeep of the broadcast communication equipment within Andrews HUB Melbourne facility Maintain proper documentation of all Audio and Communications systems. Provide technical assistance for mobile fleet communications and audio systems integration to the Hubs. Effective collaboration with Melbourne and Sydney Hub teams. Required Skills And Attributes Technical or associate degree desired, however all relevant experience will be considered. Connectivity, configuration, and operation of RTS communications systems Knowledge of Riedel communications systems is a plus. Understanding of audio console connectivity, configuration, and operations, with particular focus on LAWO and Calrec Knowledge of IP audio transmission standards, their practical use and conversion between standards. Prior experience in the broadcast industry. Excellent communication, problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to multi-task several priorities and possess solid time management skills. Collaborate with managers, engineers, and clients on projects and ideas to ensure the consistency and high availability of the communication infrastructure. Technical support background is a plus. Benefits of working at NEP Salary continuance insurance NEP Days – additional 5 days of leave per year (conditions apply) NEP Travel benefits & discounts including Qantas Club Membership Discounts through Employment Hero Work app Employee Assistance Programme If you feel you have the right match of skills for this position and are available to work weekends submit your application here! Sponsorship to work in Australia will be considered for this role. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. About Our Process At NEP, we are committed to employing individuals who align with Our Values and meet the requirements of the role. As part of the recruitment process, there are several checks which may be conducted to demonstrate applicants' suitability for a role including police / criminal background checks, right to work checks, and reference checks. For over 30 years, NEP has been the leading worldwide technical production partner for content producers of live sports, entertainment, and corporate events. Our innovative, end-to-end solutions include centralized and remote production, specialty capture, wireless video and audio, virtual and live studio production, AV and lighting services, host broadcast support, post-production, connectivity and transmission, premium playout, software-based products, and integrated managed services. With operations in 25 countries and 4,000+ employees, we have supported productions in 88 countries on all seven continents. Anywhere, anytime, on any platform—we help our clients make, manage, and show the world their content.

review_candidates.description: Job Overview The Associate Medical Director will provide medical, clinical and scientific advisory expertise to all IQVIA divisions as requested. Participate in all aspects of Medical Science involvement on assigned trials. Serve as a medical expert during project delivery lifecycle. Provide therapeutic and medical expertise to business development activities. Essential Functions Medical Monitoring: Primarily serves as Global Medical Advisor on assigned projects. Serves as Scientific Advisor and provides guidance to Project Leaders on the medical and scientific aspects of assigned projects. Provides medical support to investigative sites and project staff for protocol-related issues including protocol clarifications, inclusion/exclusion determinations, and issues of patient safety and/or eligibility. Performs medical review of the protocol, Investigative Drug Brochure (IDB), and/or Case Report Forms (CRFs). Provides therapeutic area/indication training for the project clinical team. Attends and presents at Investigator Meetings. Performs review and clarification of trial-related Adverse Events (AEs). May perform medical case review of Serious Adverse Events (SAEs), including review of case documentation and patient narrative, in collaboration with the Pharmacovigilance department. May provide medical support for the Analysis of Similar Events (AOSE), in collaboration with or on behalf of Pharmacovigilance department. May perform medical review of adverse event coding. Performs review of the Clinical Study Report (CSR) and patient narratives. Attends Kick-Off meetings, weekly team meetings, and client meetings, as needed or requested. Available 24/7 to respond urgent protocol -related questions from investigative sites, in accordance with local labor laws. May require regular travel (15%-20%) Qualifications & Requirements Medical Degree from an accredited and internationally recognized medical school with a curriculum relevant to general medical education, along with a medical license, or equivalent, from the country or region in which he/she resides and works is required, plus a minimum of 5 years' experience in clinical medicine, in addition to clinical trials experience as an investigator or in the Pharma, CRO, or Biotech industry. Robust and current knowledge of scientific, clinical, regulatory, commercial and competitive landscape in applicable therapeutic area. Board Certified Experience or knowledge in Phase I studies or early clinical development. Fluent English. Extensive communication skills. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism. At IQVIA, we believe that diversity, inclusion, and belonging empower our mission to accelerate innovation for a healthier world. We create a culture of belonging by valuing the perspectives of all talented employees worldwide and providing them with the opportunity to power smarter healthcare for everyone, everywhere. When our talented employees bring their authentic selves and their diverse experiences to work, they enable us to accomplish extraordinary things. Multifaceted thought processes spark innovation. Multi-talented collaboration harnesses innovation to deliver superior outcomes. Likewise, as part of this culture, IQVIA is committed to ensuring effective equality between women and men, integrating it as a strategic principle in its corporate and human resources policies.
